testId: testim-migrated/tests/webstore/order-receipt/validate-configurable-products-in-order-receipt.spec.ts > Webstore - Order Receipt > validate configurable products in order receipt

scenario.summary: A registered retail user signs in with the test's own account, empties the cart, adds two variants of a configurable product (variant 1 x2 and variant 2 x1, each picked by Bulb Size / Color / Technology, with DisplayText personalization and a radio add-on), checks out with Custom Flat Rate shipping and COD and places the order, then checks the receipt sections, both variant lines (quantity x item price == total price), totals and Reorder/Print; reorders to checkout without placing it.
steps: Open the webstore logged out, click Sign In, sign in with the dedicated account (masked credentials from the test data), empty the cart and check the empty-cart message

Search the configurable parent SKU; result name equals searchResultName; open the PDP; heading equals productHeading; attribute groups Bulb Size / Color / Technology, DisplayText label and 'Add-on options' heading shown
Select variant 1 (varient1BulbSize / Technology / Color swatches), type displayText, quantity varient1ProductQuantity (2), pick radio add-on addOnRadioId; add to cart
Re-open the PDP; select variant 2 (Medium / Yellow / Halogen), displayText, quantity 1, the same radio add-on; add to cart
Proceed to checkout from the cart; select Ship Complete + Custom Flat Rate (FLAT); select COD; place the order
Receipt: thank-you banner and #OS- order number message; Details, Billing To, Shipping To sections
Receipt totals: subtotal + shipping + handling + tax - discounts == order total
Receipt: Reorder, Print and Continue Shopping controls; click Reorder, proceed to checkout, pick FLAT shipping, check the Payment Method heading, select COD (no second order is placed)
stateChanges: Declared account's cart emptied at the start (cartPage.empty)

A new COD order with Custom Flat Rate shipping is placed on the declared account by the test (created-by-test; OS-<date>-<n>); it is not deleted afterwards and stays in the account's order history; inventory of the ordered items is reserved/decremented by the ordered quantity
If the account has active vouchers, the webstore checkout may auto-apply them and the order spends voucher balance (not restored)

Reorder from the receipt puts the ordered items back into the account's cart and opens checkout (shipping + COD selected) without placing a second order; the cart is left filled (the next run empties it)
assertions: Sign-in button text 'Sign In'; greeting matches /Hello,/; cart empty message equals shoppingCartEmptyValidationMessage
Checkout: 'Order Summary', 'Shipping Method', 'Order Total' labels, payment type heading visible, 'Place Order' button
Receipt banner equals thankYouMessageForPurchaseOrder; thanks text matches THANKS_RE (store name + #OS- order number)
Receipt Details / Billing / Shipping sections and Order Summary headers (Item, Status, Tracking Number, Quantity, Item Price, Total Price)
subtotal + shipping + handling + tax - shipping discount - discount equals the order total within 0.01
Reorder link 'Reorder', Print button 'Print', Continue Shopping label equals continueShoppingLabel; after Reorder -> checkout, 'Payment Method' heading
PDP: first result name, product heading, attribute group labels, 'DisplayText' label, 'Add-on options' heading, 'Add to Cart'
Each variant line (by variant SKU): quantity equals the variant's quantity; quantity x item price == total price (prices read from the page, not hard-coded)
evidence: Title 'validate configurable products in order receipt'; step labels 1) to 9) match the flow

Need product PRODUCT_CONFIGURABLE_WITH_VARIANTS: minVariants 2 (two variants ordered), quantityUsed 2 (highest variant quantity), minAddOns 1 + addOnDisplayType RadioButton (selectVariant clicks #add-on-value-radio-<id>), minPersonalizableAttributes 1 + personalizationAttribute DisplayText (#DisplayText filled), variantAttributes BulbSize,Color,Technology (swatches by alt text; labels asserted as 'Bulb Size', 'Color', 'Technology'), as in the approved save-cart and cart-headers entries for B-100003

Mapping: productSKU -> parentProductSku, searchResultName -> name, varient1/2Sku -> variant1Sku / variant2Sku, varient1/2BulbSize -> variantNAttr1, varient1/2Color -> variantNAttr2, varient1/2Technology -> variantNAttr3 (assumption: AttrN follows the variantAttributes order BulbSize,Color,Technology)

productHeading '75-Watt Equivalent BR40 ... (12-Pack)' is the name of z-2510001 (variant 1, profile): mapped to variant1Name. DOUBT: the PDP heading shows the default variant, which need not be the key's variant1 (first qualifying by SKU)

addOnRadioId '523-z-2530005' is <add-on product id>-<add-on SKU> (tda rows: ZnodePublishProductEntity ZnodeProductId 523 = SKU z-2530005, an add-on child of PimAddOnProductId 4/8/44): role data without output, the migrated spec composes it from product.addOnProductId + '-' + product.addOnSku

Profile: B-100003 active published ConfigurableProduct, storefrontProductIndex 1, requiredAddOnCount 1 (<= minAddOns 1); z-2510001 inventory 1000; z-2510012 has NO inventory row (product_stock NOT_FOUND, not filtered by store), yet tda readiness (2026-11-03) reports the own record qualifies under the key's store-scoped checks
Item and total prices are read from the receipt and only their relationship is checked: no amount is hard-coded
displayText 'AutomationTest' is text the test types (config); quantities 2 and 1 are config; '2' (toBeCloseTo digits) and '0.01' (tolerance) are config
migrate: addOnRadioId has no single output of PRODUCT_CONFIGURABLE_WITH_VARIANTS (composite id), and productHeading depends on the PDP default variant (rule 2 fails)

Account: the spec signs in with its OWN dedicated account from the test data (username/password masked, storageState empty): USER_WEBSTORE_REGISTERED with preferred.required true on the username credential source; the migrated spec declares it with testData.useExisting('user', data.username)

checkoutPage.selectShippingMethod clicks Ship Complete then lblShippingMethodFLAT (Custom Flat Rate): SHIPPING_FLAT_RATE_ON_STORE shippingCode FLAT; the destination is the account's default address (not in the test data), countries 'us' is an assumption as in the approved checkout COD retail entry

DOUBT: checkout goes straight to shipping, so the account must already have a default billing/shipping address; USER_WEBSTORE_REGISTERED does not constrain that (ADDRESS_DEFAULT_IDS_OF_USER owner=@user.userId could be added as a precondition check)

DOUBT (vouchers): retail accounts on atstage can have their own vouchers auto-applied at webstore checkout (memory 2026-11-01/02: 88RXQ9C5YT zeroed an order; created orders showed 'Voucher + COD'). orderReceiptPage.getTotals reads subtotal, shipping, handling, tax, shipping discount, discount and order total only, so an applied voucher line would break the order-total check, and each run would spend the account's voucher balance. No key expresses 'account without active vouchers' (the account is the declared one)
The order is created by the UI checkout (stateChanges, created-by-test), not a need; no collection is involved, so the run teardown does not delete it
THANKS_RE (spec code regex) names the store 'Maxwell's Hardware' and the #OS-\d{8}-\d{5} order number pattern: fixed for store MaxwellsHardware; not a scan value
Store MaxwellsHardware as in the approved shopping-cart, checkout and PDP entries (the spec names none); no linked cases, no AIO files
